structure constants, known as “equivariant Schubert calculus”, are known to be positive

Our recurrence is not manifestly positive, alas, though in practice it frequently has no
negative terms (see the comment on “anti-Grassmannian permutations” below). More-
over, unlike computations based on representatives for the Schubert classes (e.g. Schubert
polynomials, or as in [B]), this algorithm does not require us to compute a full product of
two Schubert classes in order to extract just one term.
